thought.text:
Betul, sudah saya buktikan: prefix diteruskan mentah ke nomask dan ditolak. Jadi itu jalan buntu.

Ada satu kemungkinan yang belum dicoba: nomask lewat **gateway LiteLLM**. Saya cek dulu.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && K="nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR"; echo "=== /v1/models lengkap (cari alias berprefix) ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/models" | python3 -c "
import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin)
ids=[m['id'] for m in d['data']]
print('total:',len(ids))
print('berprefix:',[i for i in ids if '/' in i] or 'TIDAK ADA')
print('contoh:',ids[:4])
"; echo "=== cek header/server ==="; curl -s -I --max-time 20 "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/models" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" | grep -iE "server|x-|litellm" | head -5
